expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Record the operating costs that reduce the business result. Stock purchases and returns are handled by their own Commerce records.
expenses.tooltip: Use Expenses for money the business spends to operate. Do not manually record stock buying value or returns here because Commerce already accounts for those events.
expenses.editHelp: Correct the original expense details without creating a second expense record.
expenses.saveError: Tunakuza could not record this expense.
expenses.updateError: Tunakuza could not update this expense.
expenses.empty: No expenses match this period and category.
expenses.receiptHelp: Tunakuza's audit record for this business expense.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set business spending projections and compare them with what actually happened. Budgets report performance; they never block spending.
budgets.saveError: Tunakuza could not save this budget.
budgets.reportingHelp: Tunakuza reports when actual spending approaches or exceeds the plan. It does not stop the business from spending.
budgets.empty: No budgets have been set yet.

scope.daily: Daily budgets compare the selected day's recorded operating expenses with the planned amount.
scope.weekly: Weekly budgets compare recorded operating expenses for the selected week with the planned amount.
scope.monthly: Monthly budgets compare the business plan with operating expenses plus stock acquisition spending recorded during that month.
